{{Top|leg}}
The '''viewplate''' was a piece of clear, reinforced plastic on the end of a pair of [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] or helmets. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] had one in his helmet, as did [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].
